digest.component_or_area: plan-review eval specs and eval solver fixtures
propositions: Eval specs and gold-set expectation strings still assert against SC vocabulary that the reviewer prompts no longer produce.
The eval solver at eval_solver.py:317 emits both '## Acceptance Criteria' and '## Success Criteria' headings with duplicated text into every generated fixture, reintroducing the removed heading.
The fix drops the trailing '## Success Criteria' block entirely so each generated fixture contains exactly one criteria heading.
Gold-set expectation strings are edited for vocabulary only and must leave the pass/fail tally unchanged (30 cases, 6 per category, 6 drops, 24 preserves).
A test must assert a solver-generated fixture description contains '## Acceptance Criteria' exactly once and no '## Success Criteria'.
Four permanent vocabulary carve-outs (plan_review_T2.md, verifier prompts, dod_uncertifiable, completion.py:288) are out of scope and must not be touched.
